settings.title: Measure The Room
settings.text: Width × depth × ceiling height — note radiators, sockets and windows.

settings.title: Check Access
settings.text: Doorways, hallways and staircase widths — especially for corner sofas.

settings.title: Allow Clearance
settings.text: Leave at least 45 cm for walkways and 30 cm to the coffee table.

settings.title: Mark The Footprint
settings.text: Use masking tape on the floor to visualise the sofa's size in the room.

settings.title: Filter & Shop
settings.text: Use the Sofa Sizer above to match your dimensions, colour, shape and budget.
